reviews.text: The Perfect Blurring Lip Liner!I am absolutely in love with the UNLEASHIA Oh! Happy Day Lip Pencil! The packaging is incredibly chic, lightweight, and convenient for tossing into my daily makeup bag.What impressed me the most is the ultra-smooth, creamy texture. Unlike other matte lip liners that drag or highlight dry patches, this crayon glides effortlessly across the edges of my lips without any tugging. The formula is beautifully pigmented yet soft, making it incredibly easy to smudge out with a fingertip or brush to achieve that trendy, soft-focus, blurred overlip look..
reviews.zh: 最完美嘅模糊唇線筆！我真係好愛 UNLEASHIA Oh! Happy Day 唇筆！包裝好有型、好輕，好方便扔入我日常嘅化妝袋。最令我印象深刻嘅係超級順滑、綿密嘅質地。唔似其他霧面唇線筆會拖曳或者突顯乾燥嘅位置，呢支唇筆可以毫不費力咁喺唇邊滑過，唔會有拉扯感。上色效果好靚，但質地又柔和，所以好容易用指尖或者刷子推開，做出潮流嘅柔焦、模糊唇邊效果。

reviews.text:
These lip pencils are pretty good (keep in mind that I am new to lip pencils, so I don't have many others to compare these to). They are soft, buttery, easily blendable. I wish they had some sort of blending brush attached to the pencils themselves, but alas.

The colors are mostly as pictured, albeit a bit duller.
reviews.zh:
呢款唇筆幾好（要留意，我係第一次用唇筆，所以冇好多其他嘢可以比較）。佢哋質地軟、油潤、易於暈染。我希望筆身上面可以附有暈染刷，可惜冇。

顏色大致同相片差唔多，只係就稍為暗淡少少。

reviews.text:
i’ve been using this pencil for a few weeks and i’m kinda obsessed. the texture is so soft and creamy—it glides on like a dream and then sets to a matte, powdery finish that lasts all day ￼.

it’s versatile af—you can line your lips, smudge it for an overlip style, or even use it as blush or eyeshadow in a pinch ￼. honestly, it’s become my on-the-go makeup hack.

i will say, if your lips are dry it can highlight lines a bit. some reviews mention it emphasizing flakes or fine lines, so i always exfoliate and use a balm under, especially in deeper shades ￼ ￼. also, because it sets fast into a film, layering can get patchy if you don’t blend quickly.

but once it clicks, it’s long‑lasting and comfy—not drying, not sticky—just a chill mattified base that stays.
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢支唇筆幾個星期，有啲上癮。質地好軟、好綿密——好似夢咁順滑咁推開，然後定型成為霧面、粉質嘅效果，可以持續成日。

佢超級百搭——你可以用嚟畫唇線，或者暈染做上唇效果，急嘅時候甚至可以當腮紅或者眼影用。老實講，佢已經成為我外出時嘅化妝小撇步。

我要講，如果你嘅唇乾，佢可能會令唇紋更突出。有啲評論話佢會突出死皮或者細紋，所以我每次都會先去角質，底下用潤唇膏，特別係深色嘅色號 ￼ ￼。另外，因為佢好快定型成膜，如果你唔快啲推開，疊色時可能會斑駁。

但係一旦掌握到，佢就持久又舒適——唔會乾，唔會黏——就係一個清爽嘅霧面底，會一直留住。

reviews.text: It's a pale pinkish lavender color that is good to provide base for layering lipstick colors. I have naturally dark lip color and always have problem getting any lipstick color to show correctly. when I use light or pale colored lipstick or tint, It either doesn't show at all or looks awkward like the color just floats on my lips. This lip pencil actually masks my lip naturally so I can layer to achieve more 3D look.
reviews.zh: 係一個淺粉紫色調嘅色號，適合做底色，方便疊搽唇膏色。我嘅唇色天生偏深，所以每次用任何唇膏都好難顯色。當我用淺色嘅唇膏或者唇彩嗰陣，要麼完全顯唔出嚟，要麼睇落好怪，就好似顏色浮喺唇上咁。呢支唇筆其實可以自然咁遮蓋我嘅唇色，所以我可以疊色，做出更立體嘅效果。

reviews.text: I use this to contour my Cupid's bow, under my bottom lip and even on my nose. The product is smooth and blendable. You can see that the left Swatch looks more blended. I've only went over it lightly with my finger, and on the right Swatch you can see how it looks like layered and not blended. I got the shade No.7 Burnt Toast 😊
reviews.zh: 我用呢款嚟修飾我嘅唇峰、下唇底下，甚至鼻樑都用。產品順滑、易推開。你可以睇到左邊嗰個色卡比較融合。我只係用手指輕輕推咗一下，而右邊嗰個色卡，你可以睇到好似疊咗色、冇推開。我買嘅係 7 號 Burnt Toast 😊

reviews.text:
they're kinda.. tints!? Just make sure to blot excess away and let sit. I found out by dying swatch tests so they sat longer. after swatching the 06 afterparty. I immediately hard swiped it and yea look at that 04 baebae. it's great to know that they're not easy to remove unless I'm doing multiple hard wipes. my fear was lip liners for this reason lol but i shouldn't have been surprised of unleashia. their tints are underrated. and now I know their lip liners are too.

if I were to compare swatches to liptints i use. the afterparty is a mauve similar to etude tint's midnight mauve and baebae reminds me a slightly more muted version of the etude lip tint's mellow peach.
reviews.zh:
佢哋好似……唇彩咁！記得用紙巾吸走多餘嘅位，然後等一陣。我係通過乾咗嘅色卡測試先發現，所以佢哋會留得耐啲。我試咗 06 afterparty 色卡之後，即刻用力擦咗一下，睇吓 04 baebae 點。知道佢哋唔容易擦走，除非我用多次用力擦，都係一件好事。我一直怕唇筆會有呢個問題 lol，但係唔應該驚訝 Unleashia 嘅產品。佢哋嘅唇彩被低估咗。而家我知道佢哋嘅唇筆都係咁。

如果同我用過嘅唇彩比較，afterparty 係一種類似 Etude tint 嘅 midnight mauve 嘅煙紫色，而 baebae 就似係 Etude lip tint 嘅 mellow peach 嘅淡啲、霧啲版本。

reviews.text: Gorgeous shade. I expected it to be darker, yet it’s still a perfect shade. It’s very buttery and easy to blend, it gives that blurring effect. The first image (dim lighting) the lip liner is on the outer edges with some lipstick in the center. The second image shows just the lip liner. The lip liner could be made dark depending on how much you use, blend or if you neutralize your lip color with foundation.
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅色號。我原本以為會深啲，但係依然係一個好完美嘅色號。質地好綿、好易推開，可以做出模糊效果。第一張相（燈光較暗）係唇線筆喺唇邊，中間係一啲唇膏。第二張相就只係唇線筆。唇線筆嘅顏色可以深淺不同，視乎你用幾多、推開幾多，或者係咪用粉底中和你嘅唇色。

reviews.text: this lasts all day and I’m not even joking. It’s smudge proof (ate so much today and it’s still on my lips at the end of the day without touch ups). I also wanted to swatch it on my hand so I did AND IT STAYED ON WHILE WASHING MY HANDS TWICE AND I TRIED TO REMOVE IT WITH PAPER AND WATER IT DID NOT BUDGE😭. save to say that this is worth at least trying because the lasting power on this is crazy good plus it looks so good on the lips!
reviews.zh: 真係持久到成日，我冇講笑。佢防暈染（今日食咗好多嘢，到日終都仲留喺唇上，冇補妝）。我又想喺手上試色，所以試咗，結果洗咗兩次手都仲留喺度，我用紙巾同水都擦唔走😭。可以話，呢款至少值得試吓，因為持久力真係好勁，而且搽喺唇上都好靚！
